evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Equating an unrehearsed rollback with not having one frames rehearsal as the competence condition for security; the aphoristic construction performs conservation (keeping what works by proving it works).
Instituting a recurring cadence for rehearsals appeals to conservation — stability and security through regularized practice.
Assigning a named owner frames rollback readiness as a capability someone is accountable for mastering — competence as owned craft.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNotHeld
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the value move here equating a capability with its proven exercise — treating untested readiness as absence of the capability itself?
